```python
import argparse
import sys
import re
from pysilfont.ufo import Ufont
from pysilfont.ftml import FTMLBuilder
from pysilfont.glyphdata import readGlyphData

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate FTML from UFO and glyph data CSV using pysilfont.")
    parser.add_argument("--input-ufo", required=True, help="Input UFO directory")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, help="Output FTML file")
    parser.add_argument("--glyph-info-csv", required=True, help="Glyph info CSV file")
    parser.add_argument("--font-code", default="", help="Font code")
    parser.add_argument("--log", default=None, help="Log file name")
    parser.add_argument("--langs", nargs="*", default=[], help="List of BCP47 language tags")
    parser.add_argument("--rtl", action="store_true", help="Enable right-to-left feature")
    parser.add_argument("--no-render-check", action="store_true", help="Disable rendering check")
    parser.add_argument("--test-name", default="Test", help="Test name")
    parser.add_argument("--font-src", default="", help="Font source")
    parser.add_argument("--text-scale", type=float, default=1.0, help="Text scaling factor")
    parser.add_argument("--anchor-re", default=None, help="Anchor points regular expression")
    parser.add_argument("--total-width", type=int, default=0, help="Total width of all string column")
    parser.add_argument("--xsl", default=None, help="XSL stylesheet")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Set up logging if requested
    if args.log:
        import logging
        logging.basicConfig(filename=args.log, level=logging.INFO)
        logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    else:
        logger = None

    # Read glyph data CSV
    glyph_data = readGlyphData(args.glyph_info_csv)

    # Load UFO font
    font = Ufont(args.input_ufo)

    # Prepare FTMLBuilder
    ftml = FTMLBuilder(
        testname=args.test_name,
        fontsrc=args.font_src,
        fontcode=args.font_code,
        langs=args.langs,
        rtl=args.rtl,
        rendercheck=not args.no_render_check,
        textscale=args.text_scale,
        anchor_re=args.anchor_re,
        totalwidth=args.total_width,
        xsl=args.xsl
    )

    # Add encoded characters
    for glyphname, data in glyph_data.items():
        if "unicode" in data and data["unicode"]:
            ftml.addChar(
                glyphname=glyphname,
                font=font,
                codepoint=int(data["unicode"], 16),
                comment=data.get("comment", ""),
                lang=data.get("lang", None)
            )

    # Add unencoded specials and ligatures
    for glyphname, data in glyph_data.items():
        if not data.get("unicode"):
            if data.get("special"):
                ftml.addSpecial(
                    glyphname=glyphname,
                    font=font,
                    comment=data.get("comment", ""),
                    lang=data.get("lang", None)
                )
            elif data.get("ligature"):
                ftml.addSpecial(
                    glyphname=glyphname,
                    font=font,
                    comment=data.get("comment", ""),
                    lang=data.get("lang", None)
                )

    # Add Lam-Alef data if present
    for glyphname, data in glyph_data.items():
        if data.get("lamalef"):
            ftml.addSpecial(
                glyphname=glyphname,
                font=font,
                comment="Lam-Alef: " + data.get("comment", ""),
                lang=data.get("lang", None)
            )

    # Add diacritic attachment data if anchor regex is provided
    if args.anchor_re:
        anchor_re = re.compile(args.anchor_re)
        for glyphname, data in glyph_data.items():
            anchors = [a for a in data.get("anchors", []) if anchor_re.match(a)]
            if anchors:
                ftml.addSpecial(
                    glyphname=glyphname,
                    font=font,
                    comment="Anchors: " + ", ".join(anchors),
                    lang=data.get("lang", None)
                )

    # Write FTML to output file
    ftml.write_to_file(args.output)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
